subject: BUG-234: arena member can write any field (in-room cheating)
description: The 2026-08-29 arena_sessions membership fix closes OUTSIDER access but places no restriction on WHICH fields a member may write. An alpha player can overwrite teams.bravo.state, forge the opponent's progress, or flip winner mid-match. Membership is trivially obtained -- a room code is the ticket, by design. NOT a regression: the pre-fix rule allowed strictly more (any signed-in user could do all of this without joining). Host-only was deliberately rejected because surrender() sets winner/status from a NON-host (CoOpSync.js:938), so host-only would break VS mode. Fix needs field-level scoping, likely request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys(): a member may write their own player entry and their own team's state, and winner/status need a rule that permits surrender without permitting a unilateral win. Bigger than the outsider fix and deserves its own review. Raised by Nancy 2026-08-29. See _docs/operations/BUG_TRACKER.md BUG-234 and commit 9ec369431.
